name: glitchless
description: Glitchless for Claude Code: add game observability to a Three.js, Phaser, Babylon.js, PlayCanvas, Unity, Godot or Unreal game, then triage and fix what players actually hit — frame-time hitches, leaks, errors and difficulty spikes — using production telemetry (Glitchless MCP) and the live game (WebMCP).
